At t>=1 the primal shift fails to decay. Reproduction with standard-library exact-rational arithmetic confirms recurrences, heterogeneous three-agent conditional dynamics, finite-prefix saturated likelihood ratios, and the rational epsilon=84/19 certificate. Finite checks are supplementary, not an infinite proof.
